addendum20261118.question: Can the original selected LayerStates source projection safely omit the complete LAYER-to-LTYPE-to-unnamed STYLE chain?
addendum20261118.sourceControlGate: No direct source-consistent omission is established. dx_data::getLayerTableControlExtensionDictionary requires the live DWG LAYER count to equal the same-import published LAYER_CONTROL handle count, with every source layer handle occurring uniquely and owned by that control. Erasing Arch_Section_Insul 0x3A7 therefore fails the existing original-control membership proof before LayerStates output. Removing only BATTING 0x363 or STYLE 0x3CD leaves a retained incoming reference. Mutating the source layer, fabricating membership or switching the source format to Unknown would create a different test projection and does not preserve the original source claim.

primaryReferences.finding: STYLE flag 1 identifies a shape-file entry and group 3 carries its font filename. This documentation alone does not establish native acceptance of this exact empty-name source/target profile.
LTYPE group 74 bit 4 denotes an embedded shape, and group 340 points to its STYLE object.

addendum20261118.relatedPeerEvidence: The different AC1015 sample in p4-ac1015-entities3d-style-empty-name-oda-gui-2026-11-07.json produced an empty-name shape STYLE in ODA output, but its SHAPE entity was absent; that observation does not establish the current AC1021 shape-linetype graph or native semantics.
addendum20261118.nextWitness: Obtain a hash-bound, independently produced native AC1021 DWG and matching AC1021/AC1024 DXF with a layer using a shape-bearing linetype whose 340 targets an empty-name shape STYLE; record producer/version and source provenance. Independently inspect exact STYLE flag/name/font and every LTYPE segment/340, layer-to-LTYPE relation and output identity; open/reopen in a native consumer with the needed shape font and verify behavior. For this local source, an independently qualified same-source peer conversion and fresh consumer readback can also establish the physical graph and any omission/remapping, but unauthenticated input remains a provenance limit. Preserve rollback and same-adapter retry and both output encodings when implementing a narrowly qualified profile.
addendum20261118.disposition: Keep the original DWG export guard and source-control membership unchanged. An independently qualified shape-style output route is the useful path for retaining this entire original graph; a separately designed projection may be tested but cannot be described as preserving the original complete source control. No native, platform, producer-wide or support claim is promoted, and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
